description: Allowlist of skills that make sense applied locally to a single component. The component bootstrap skills (component-make-new, component-make-new-actor, component-new-version, component-like-existing) copy ONLY skills whose names match an 'include' pattern below into a new component's .claude/skills. Update this file to change what gets copied. Patterns support a trailing '*' wildcard; entries without '*' match exactly.

excludedRationale.component-make-new, component-make-new-a: component lifecycle/scaffolding — run at the workspace level, not from inside a component
excludedRationale.profile-*: platform/system-wide performance benchmarking, not scoped to one component
excludedRationale.design-artifacts-update: operates on the certus-server-yaml profile, not a single component
excludedRationale.tools-count-sloc: reports metrics for the whole code base
excludedRationale.tools-speckit-init: bootstraps spec-kit in a directory; already done during component creation
excludedRationale.save: session-transcript utility, unrelated to a component
